label: Sheaves
rationale: The Stacks Project has a dedicated sheaf foundation.

label: Sheaves of modules
rationale: Sheaves of modules on ringed sites and spaces are developed directly.

label: Coherent sheaves
rationale: Coherent modules and coherent sheaves on locally Noetherian schemes are explicit.

label: Sheaf cohomology
rationale: Derived sheaf cohomology is developed directly.

label: Cech cohomology
rationale: Cech complexes and their comparison with sheaf cohomology are explicit.

label: Algebraic varieties
rationale: The varieties chapter supplies the modern scheme-theoretic setting.

label: Affine coherent correspondence
rationale: Quasi-coherent modules on affine schemes and their module correspondence are explicit.

label: Modules and associated sheaves
rationale: The affine module-to-sheaf equivalence is explicit.

label: Projective schemes
rationale: Projective space and relative Proj are developed directly.

label: Graded modules and Proj
rationale: The graded algebra and relative Proj constructions are explicit.

label: Ext
rationale: Derived Ext and sheaf Ext have dedicated sections.

label: Support
rationale: Support of modules is developed directly.

label: Hilbert polynomial
rationale: The varieties chapter records Hilbert polynomials but not every historical formulation.

label: Euler characteristic
rationale: Euler characteristics and arithmetic genera are treated in the varieties setting.

label: Cohomological vanishing
rationale: Coherent cohomology vanishing and ampleness criteria are explicit.
